blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The easterlies will bring scattered to isolated rains to most parts of the country on Friday, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the easterlies are affecting all areas, except Ilocos Region, Cordillera Administrative Region and Cagayan Valley. These places in Northern Luzon will be affected by the northeast monsoon, or “amihan.” “The easterlies will bring warm and humid weather to the rest of the country,” Pagasa weather specialist Leanne Loreto stated in the morning broadcast.
